name: run_on_actor
description: Runs Luau source on the thread associated with a target Actor Instance. The call returns no values produced by the dispatched source.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: Actor Instance whose associated thread should run the source.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Non-empty Luau source string to run on the Actor thread.

parameters.name: ...arguments
parameters.description: Additional values passed to the dispatched source when supported.
